nodes.description: Public total token supply variable (declared in EIP20Interface, set in VinzCoin constructor).
Mapping address => uint256 holding token balances for each account.
Nested mapping address => address => uint256 storing spending allowances.
Public token display name string.
Public uint8 number of decimals used for display.
Public token symbol string.
Constant private MAX_UINT256 = 2**256 - 1 used as the infinite-allowance sentinel.
Constructor: mints the whole initial amount to the deployer and sets name, decimals and symbol.
Transfers _value tokens from msg.sender to _to, updating balances without SafeMath.
Transfers _value tokens from _from to _to using msg.sender allowance, decrementing allowance unless infinite.
View function returning the balance of _owner.
Sets the allowance msg.sender grants to _spender to _value.
View function returning the remaining allowance of _spender over _owner.
Caller-supplied address used as balance owner and allowance owner across the contract.
balances[msg.sender] -= _value unchecked subtraction in transfer (integer underflow risk).
balances[_to] += _value unchecked addition in transfer (integer overflow risk).
balances[_to] += _value unchecked addition in transferFrom (integer overflow risk).
balances[_from] -= _value unchecked subtraction in transferFrom (integer underflow risk).
allowed[_from][msg.sender] -= _value unchecked subtraction inside the MAX_UINT256 guard.
Constructor parameter: total amount of tokens minted to the creator.
Constructor parameter: token display name.
Constructor parameter: number of decimals for display.
Constructor parameter: token symbol identifier.
transfer parameter _to: recipient address.
transfer parameter _value: amount of tokens to move.
transferFrom parameter _from: source address whose tokens are spent.
transferFrom parameter _to: recipient address.
transferFrom parameter _value: amount of tokens to move.
balanceOf parameter _owner: address whose balance is queried.
approve parameter _spender: address allowed to spend tokens.
approve parameter _value: allowance amount granted.
allowance parameter _owner: token owner queried.
allowance parameter _spender: spender queried.
Local variable allowance caching allowed[_from][msg.sender] in transferFrom.

edges.reason: Constructor parameter _initialAmount flows into totalSupply and the creator balance assignment.
Constructor parameter _tokenName is written into the name state variable.
Constructor parameter _decimalUnits is written into the decimals state variable.
Constructor parameter _tokenSymbol is written into the symbol state variable.
transfer recipient parameter _to is used as the key written in balances.
transfer amount parameter _value drives the balance updates.
transferFrom source parameter _from indexes balances and allowed.
transferFrom recipient parameter _to is credited in balances.
transferFrom amount parameter _value drives all arithmetic in the function.
balanceOf parameter _owner indexes the balances mapping.
approve parameter _spender is the inner key of the allowed mapping write.
approve parameter _value is stored as the allowance.
allowance parameter _owner indexes the allowed mapping.
allowance parameter _spender is the second key read from allowed.
Local allowance variable caches allowed[_from][msg.sender] and is consumed in require and subtraction.
transfer performs balances[msg.sender] -= _value without SafeMath.
transfer performs balances[_to] += _value without SafeMath.
transferFrom performs balances[_to] += _value without SafeMath.
transferFrom performs balances[_from] -= _value without SafeMath.
transferFrom performs allowed[_from][msg.sender] -= _value without SafeMath.
Unchecked subtraction writes the new sender balance into balances.
Unchecked addition writes the new recipient balance into balances.
Unchecked addition writes the recipient balance into balances.
Unchecked subtraction writes the source balance into balances.
Unchecked subtraction writes the remaining allowance into allowed.
transfer reads balances[msg.sender] for the require check and for the debit.
transferFrom reads balances[_from] for the require check and for the debit.
balanceOf returns balances[_owner].
transferFrom reads allowed[_from][msg.sender] into the local allowance.
approve reads then overwrites allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
allowance returns allowed[_owner][_spender].
MAX_UINT256 is compared against the allowance to decide whether to decrement it.
Constructor sets totalSupply = _initialAmount.
Constructor mints balances[msg.sender] = _initialAmount.
Constructor sets the name state variable.
Constructor sets the decimals state variable.
Constructor sets the symbol state variable.
approve writes the new allowance into allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
Constructor credits balances[msg.sender] with the entire initial supply.
transfer debits and credits using msg.sender as the source account.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the allowance owner key.
approve stores the allowance under msg.sender as the owner.
The unchecked allowance decrement is only reached when allowance < MAX_UINT256.
require(balances[msg.sender] >= _value) gates execution of the transfer body.
require(balances[_from] >= _value) gates execution of the transferFrom body.
require(allowance >= _value) gates execution of the transferFrom body.
balanceOf only reads the balances mapping and mutates nothing.
allowance only reads the allowed mapping and mutates nothing.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor argument is fully consumed by the constructor's minting and totalSupply assignments.
Constructor argument only feeds the name state variable write in the constructor.
Constructor argument only feeds the decimals state variable write in the constructor.
Constructor argument only feeds the symbol state variable write in the constructor.
Recipient parameter is only used as the balances key inside transfer.
Amount parameter directly drives the unchecked sender balance subtraction in transfer.
Source parameter is only used to index balances and allowed inside transferFrom.
Recipient parameter is the key of the unchecked balance addition in transferFrom.
Amount parameter directly drives the unchecked source balance subtraction in transferFrom.
Owner parameter is only used as the balances lookup key in balanceOf.
Spender parameter is only used as the inner key of the allowed write in approve.
Value parameter is only stored as the allowance value in approve.
Owner parameter is only used as the outer key of the allowed lookup in allowance.
Spender parameter is only used as the inner key of the allowed lookup in allowance.
Local cached allowance is consumed by the guarded allowance subtraction (and the require check) in transferFrom.
